script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

---

 Title: The Unexpected Friendship

 INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

 JANE, mid-30s, sits alone at a table, scrolling through her phone. She looks up as the bell above the door chimes. In walks MIKE, late-20s, holding a large bag of groceries.

 JANE
 (under her breath)
 Another day, another grocery run for Mom.

 MIKE
 (smiling)
 Hey, Jane. Busy day?

 JANE
 (sighs)
 You have no idea.

 INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

 MIKE, sitting across from JANE, tries to make small talk.

 MIKE
 So, any plans for the weekend?

 JANE
 (shrugs)
 Nothing yet. Same old stuff.

 MIKE
 (nods)
 Well, I was thinking. Since you're always running errands for your mom, how about I help out?

 JANE
 (surprised)
 What do you mean?

 MIKE
 I could tag along on your runs. You won't have to do it all alone.

 JANE
 (hesitant)
 I don't know...

 MIKE
 (leans in)
 I promise I'll make it worth your while.

 INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - DAY

 Jane is in her living room, surrounded by piles of groceries. She looks at the phone, which buzzes with a text from her mother.

 TEXT FROM MOM
 Jane, don't forget the bread!

 Jane rolls her eyes and grabs her keys.

 INT. GROCERY STORE - DAY

 Jane and Mike are in the grocery store, laughing and joking as they add items to the cart. They run into JANE'S EX-BOYFRIEND, SAM, who looks at them with a scowl.

 SAM
 (to Jane)
 I see you're still wasting your time on your mom's errands.

 MIKE
 (smiling)
 Actually, I'm here to help.

 SAM
 (angrily)
 You're not even family!

 MIKE
 (chuckles)
 Well, Jane and I are becoming pretty good friends.

 SAM
 (mutters under his breath)
 Loser.

 INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

 Jane and Mike are sitting on the couch, watching a movie.

 MIKE
 This is nice. Just hanging out, no errands, no stress.

 JANE
 (smiling)
 Yeah, it's nice.

 MIKE
 (leaning in)
 So, about the weekend...

 JANE
 (laughs)
 What did you have in mind?

 INT. LOCAL PARK - DAY

 Jane and Mike are at the park, having a picnic. They share stories about their lives and laugh at each other's jokes.

 MIKE
 (looking around)
 You know, I've never really spent much time in the park before. It's nice.

 JANE
 (smiling)
 It is.

 MIKE
 (pauses)
 So, Jane... I was wondering. Would you like to be my girlfriend?

 JANE
 (surprised)
 (pauses)
 I'd like that.

 INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

 Jane and Mike sit in the same coffee shop where they first met. They hold hands and laugh, enjoying each other's company.

 JANE
 (smiling)
 I never expected to find a friend like you, Mike.

 MIKE
 (grinning)
 And I never expected to find a love like yours, Jane.

 The screen fades to black as they share a tender kiss.

 THE END
